shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy cardigan sits at the pinboard-side window seat and asks about the project schedule, a man in a mustard sweater sits at the entrance-side window seat, a woman in an emerald blouse sits at the pinboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a burgundy polo sits at the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a navy cardigan at the pinboard-side window seat swaps seats with the man in a mustard sweater at the entrance-side window seat, who answers the question.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald blouse asks for clarification, and the man in a burgundy polo replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
